reviewFindings.evidence: The original HTTP path retained tool_execution_start only in memory before the write-ahead journal work began, leaving a hard-exit window before SessionStore received a reconciliation marker.
reviewFindings.resolutionEvidence: RunLoop now calls the synchronous PreExecutionJournal before tool_execution_start and Execute; the HTTP durable run persists exact/aggregate markers and clears only the exact marker through CommitInterruptedRun. TestDurableSessionPreExecutionJournalSurvivesHardProcessExit and the related journal/commit tests passed count=10 on 2026-08-12.

reviewFindings.evidence: ACP Backend.Prompt originally supplied RunOptions without PreExecutionJournal and committed observer state only after terminal completion, leaving a hard-exit replay window at its advertised resume ingress.
reviewFindings.resolutionEvidence: ACP now injects a per-prompt synchronous journal, uses exact MarkInterrupted/UpdateInterruptedRun CAS, enriches failure markers, rejects guarded durable-none terminals, and uses exact CommitInterruptedRun only for success. TestACPExecutionJournalSurvivesHardProcessExit runs Backend through the actual AgentRunner and real Write in a child killed after the side effect; a fresh Store/Backend blocks load and resume. The full TestACPExecutionJournal prefix passed count=10 on 2026-08-12.
